200.description:
One human gene's protein in the Human Protein Atlas, by gene symbol or synonym, Ensembl gene ID, UniProt accession or proteinatlas.org URL: every subcellular location with its own reliability grade, main or additional status and GO ID, the gene-level reliability, what Enhanced grades rest on (siRNA, independent antibodies), extracellular location, single-cell variation and cell cycle dependency; RNA tissue and single cell type specificity with the tissues and cell types that express it most (nTPM, nCPM); protein evidence (HPA, UniProt, neXtProt), protein classes, chromosome position, secretome location and function; and the IDs of HPA's antibodies for it. A symbol or accession shared by several genes is invalid_input listing them; an unknown gene is not_found.

The response contains the tool result directly.

post.description: Find proteins in a compartment (location Nucleoli, min_reliability Supported), genes enriched in a tissue (tissue liver) or cell type (cell_type hepatocytes), or both at once; then call protein for one gene's full localization and expression, or antibodies for its reagents.

cell_type.description: Single cell type name as HPA writes it, case-insensitive and usually plural: hepatocytes, T-cells, cardiomyocytes.

limit.description:
limit

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 100; default 20.

location.description:
Subcellular location term exactly as HPA names it.

Provider reference: allowed values ["Acrosome", "Actin filaments", "Aggresome", "Annulus", "Basal body", "Calyx", "Cell Junctions", "Centriolar satellite", "Centrosome", "Cleavage furrow", "Connecting piece", "Cytokinetic bridge", "Cytoplasmic bodies", "Cytosol", "End piece", "Endoplasmic reticulum", "Endosomes", "Equatorial segment", "Flagellar centriole", "Focal adhesion sites", "Golgi apparatus", "Intermediate filaments", "Kinetochore", "Lipid droplets", "Lysosomes", "Microtubule ends", "Microtubules", "Mid piece", "Midbody", "Midbody ring", "Mitochondria", "Mitotic chromosome", "Mitotic spindle", "Nuclear bodies", "Nuclear membrane", "Nuclear speckles", "Nucleoli", "Nucleoli fibrillar center", "Nucleoli rim", "Nucleoplasm", "Perinuclear theca", "Peroxisomes", "Plasma membrane", "Primary cilium", "Primary cilium tip", "Primary cilium transition zone", "Principal piece", "Rods & Rings", "Vesicles"].

main_location_only.description: Only genes with location as a main location.

min_reliability.description:
Lowest reliability of location to include; default Uncertain (all). Supported keeps Enhanced and Supported.

Provider reference: allowed values ["Enhanced", "Supported", "Approved", "Uncertain"].

offset.description:
Results to skip; pass the previous page's next_offset.

Provider reference: minimum 0; maximum 25000; default 0.

query.description: Free text (kinase, insulin receptor) or HPA search syntax (protein_class:Transcription factors), ANDed with the other filters. Field values HPA does not know match nothing rather than failing.

specificity.description: RNA specificity categories for tissue or cell_type; default all three. enriched: at least 4x every other tissue or cell type; group_enriched: 4x in a small group; enhanced: 4x the mean.

tissue.description: Tissue name as HPA writes it, case-insensitive: liver, skeletal muscle, cerebral cortex, pancreas.

200.description:
Search human genes in the Human Protein Atlas by subcellular location (one of HPA's 49 terms, with a minimum reliability and optionally main locations only), by RNA tissue or single cell type specificity (enriched, group enriched or enhanced in a named tissue or cell type), by free text or HPA search syntax, or any combination (ANDed). A location search ranks by that location's own reliability, then main before additional; a tissue or cell type search ranks by specificity, then expression there; a text search keeps HPA's order. Each result has the gene, Ensembl and UniProt IDs, the matched location with its reliability and GO ID, all main and additional locations, and the requested RNA specificity. HPA returns whole result sets, so total_count is exact and next_offset pages on. An empty result is a valid empty page; an unknown tissue or cell type name is invalid_input.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `results` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `additional_locations` | string[] | Every additional location. |
| `description` | string | Gene description. |
| `ensembl_gene_id` | string | Ensembl gene ID (unversioned), e.g. `ENSG00000141510`. |
| `gene` | string | HGNC gene symbol. |
| `location` | object | The searched location for this gene with its own reliability; null without location. |
| `main_locations` | string[] | Every main location of the protein. |
| `rna_single_cell_type` | object | RNA single cell type specificity when cell_type is set, else null. |
| `rna_tissue` | object | RNA tissue specificity when tissue is set, else null. |
| `source_url` | string | Gene page on HPA's versioned site. |
| `subcellular_reliability` | string | Gene-level reliability of HPA's immunofluorescence localization (its best location's grade); null when HPA has no cell data. |
| `uniprot_accessions` | string[] |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
